title: OpenAI acquires presentation startup NextSlide
summary: In a note on LinkedIn , Beshry said the announcement is coming “a few months late,” as the acquisition took place “earlier this year.” Beshry was previously a co-founder at Caper AI, a smart cart/cashier-less checkout startup acquired by Instacart in 2021.
